1879073379.name: Penetrating Shot: Pierce the Darkness
1879073379.desc: A damaging shot that pierces enemy mitigations.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

1879115491.name: Razor Sharp
1879115491.desc: A sweeping cut that can damage multiple targets in front of you.

1879135203.name: Improved Swift Bow: Ablaze
1879135203.desc: Loose three missiles in rapid succession.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879139043.name: Maul
1879139043.desc:
You tear into your enemy with sharp claws, drawing fresh blood.  Reduces Incoming Healing.  <rgb=#FF7700> 
 
 In Flayer: Agonizing Maul 
 Deals increased damage. 
 Brute bonus:  Applies a healing debuff. 
 
 In Shadow: Sudden Maul 
 Deals increased damage. 
 On Crit: Grants an attack speed buff.   </rgb> 

  <rgb=#00FFDD>Increased damage when attacking from behind</rgb>

1879184995.name: Ignore the Pain
1879184995.desc: Removes one poison, disease, fear, or wound effect.\n

1879191779.name: Skeleton Painted Pony
1879191779.desc: A pony painted in a festive, if frightening, visage to help celebrate Bilbo's Haunted Burrow in Hobbiton.

1879192163.name: Return to Rivendell
1879192163.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Elves, you're able to quickly return to Rivendell. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879198307.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Blood-raven)
1879198307.desc: Summons a raven companion.\n\nThe raven specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879210595.name: Improved Gut Punch
1879210595.desc: When your target begins preparing an attack, you give them a swift punch to the gut to interrupt their preparation.

1879228131.name: Fist and Shield
1879228131.desc: Capable Wardens prepare their fist and shield for attack.

1879244259.name: Keen Strike
1879244259.desc: A keen edged blade and razor wit can combine to truly potent effect. Burglars can take advantage of the stratagem trick with this keen strike.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill is enhanced by Trick: Stratagem.</rgb>

1879260643.name: Call of the Cavalry
1879260643.desc: You cry out with a renewed vigour from atop your steed, disheartening any foolish enough to stand in your way.

1879263587.name: Coup De Grâce
1879263587.desc: A powerful triple attack that deals massive damage and shocks your target, allowing you to temporarily enter Stealth.

1879288675.name: Doorward's Strike
1879288675.desc: Háma can strike one foe for serious damage.

1879302627.name: Call to Arms: Herald of Hope (Swordswoman)
1879302627.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of Hope into battle. This banner increases the mitigations of those around it.

1879315555.name: Pony of the Autumn Sun
1879315555.desc: A pony from the Fall Festival.

1879325283.name: Guide to Arnach
1879325283.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Arnach in eastern Gondor.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879369187.name: Rain-cloud
1879369187.desc: Brings out a rain-cloud to keep you company.

1879378147.name: Steed of Ered Mithrin
1879378147.desc: A steed inspired by the Grey Mountains Expedition.

1879417827.name: Steed of the Forest Spring
1879417827.desc: This steed brings to mind a living pool.

1879428067.name: Mocking Taunt
1879428067.desc: Deliver some choice words to your opponent, dealing Light-type damage. Guarantees your next Brawler mounted skill will crit.

1879458531.name: Gallant Display
1879458531.desc: An attack that wounds enemies in front of you.\n\nThis skill deals greater damage but costs more power with each subsequent use.

1879486051.name: Friend of Small Fowl (Amethyst-tailed Caller)
1879486051.desc: Summons a raven-type companion.\n\nThe amethyst-tailed caller specializes in buffing and debuffing.

1879495139.name: Calming Flower Pot
1879495139.desc: Place down a nice pot of flowers, sure to give off a calming sensation to those near you.

1879497699.name: Minor Pet Command
1879497699.desc: Command your pet to execute a minor skill on themselves or their target.

1879508579.name: Helpful Deep-claw Whelp
1879508579.desc: Summons a helpful deep-claw whelp to accompany you on your travels.

1879521379.name: Twilight Mûmak Calf
1879521379.desc: Summons a twilight mûmak calf to accompany you on your travels.

1879523683.name: Thunderclap
1879523683.desc: An attack with all the force and fury of booming thunder.

1879532387.name: Khemozêl Survival
1879532387.desc: You call on the woods for aid, instantly restoring 5% morale to yourself or a target, then 3% morale every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.
